question: In which spiritual paths do these syllables hold efficacy?
premises: The syllables are relevant in the path of yoga.
They are relevant in the path of devotion.
They are relevant in the path of liberation.
inference: These syllables are efficacious in the paths of yoga, devotion, and liberation.
plain_english: O beautiful one, in the path of yoga, in the path of devotion, and in the path of liberation.
